description: Defines the SystemInfo struct which contains system-related information such as OS, CPU, and GPU details, used in crash reporting within the Google Breakpad project.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: A struct holding system information such as OS, CPU, and GPU details, with methods to initialize and reset its data.

methods.name: SystemInfo()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes all string fields to empty and cpu_count to zero.

methods.name: Clear()
methods.description: Resets all fields of the SystemInfo object to their default empty or zero values.
